item.title: Caches
item.description: What is the problem? You have parsed a document and you would like to execute some computation on the AST. But you don’t want to do this every time you see a certain node. You want to do it once for the lifetime of a document. Where to save it? How to solve it? For data that depends on the lifetime of a document or even the entire workspace, Langium has several kinds of caches:
